sentences.en: We studied the Concordance to Shakespeare to accumulate examples of alliteration.
sentences.zh: 我们研究了莎士比亚的《圣经汇编》以收集头韵的例子。

sentences.en: When writing poetry, the author likes to use alliterations.
sentences.zh: 在写诗时，作者喜欢使用头韵。

sentences.en: Old English poetry was based on alliteration rather than end rhyme.
sentences.zh: 古英语诗歌是基于头韵而不是尾韵。
